title: WorkerProtocolV1Common
description: Shared $defs for worker-protocol v1. Frozen — additive changes only after archive.

ProtocolVersion.description: Frozen wire identifier for v1. Locked per design D2.

IssueRef.description: Tracker-native issue identifier (e.g., LIN-123, owner/repo#42, internal-board UUID).

Capability.description: Examples: agent:codex, agent:opencode, tmux, git, os:darwin, arch:arm64

LeaseSec.description: Lease duration in seconds. Server authoritative; worker echoes for diagnostics only.

ConfigHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the active workflow YAML, prefixed with sha256:. Content-addressable.

ContentHashShort.description: Bare 64-char SHA-256 hex (no scheme prefix). Used for filenames / object keys.

error.description: Stable error code (snake_case). Per-endpoint enums in their own files.

details.description: Optional endpoint-specific detail object or array.
